diagnostics.confidence_replay_scope: Exploratory post-hoc filtering of both arms' retained PR137 postclip predictions on the same development set, then full scorer replay. It cannot recover outputs removed before caching, tests no image enhancement, and does not select a new deployment threshold.
diagnostics.height_bin_note: Original-image vertical extent, rounded to 0.001px only to remove TXT floating-point boundary noise.
diagnostics.unmatched_visibility_note: Highest-IoU reference association; no physical ownership label is inferred.

scope: Complete candidate current-R38 inventory at the fixed PR137 operating point. Other unmatched is an assignment category, not a physical background verdict.
